headline: Burlington Aging Council to discuss Plan BTV 2050 Open House, Aging Council website work, and the Age Strong Burlington Action Plan.
summary: The council will discuss the Plan BTV 2050 Open House on November 5th, work on the Aging Council website, a priority measure, and next steps including the Age Strong Burlington Action Plan.
